status.description: Where the tab is: no-tab (no open claude.ai tab) | tab.

openCode.description: Open claude.ai/code in a background tab with a 45 s deadline (the SPA never settles inside the default 10 s; on failure the tab is closed). Side effect: creates a tab, which the caller closes. Pass the returned targetId to the other tools.

rect.description: Scroll the element that a JS expression evaluates to into view and return its viewport rect. Use it to place a click or a screenshot clip.

expr.description: in-page expression returning an Element, e.g. document.querySelector('[role=dialog]')

returns.description: {x, y, width, height, cx, cy} or null when absent

hoverClick.description: Real mouse click on the element an expression evaluates to: mouseMoved, 150 ms, mousePressed, mouseReleased at its centre. Works where the guarded click answers 'blocked: not_interactable_or_unsupported' and on Radix menus. Side effect: whatever the click does.

returns.description: {clicked:true, x, y}; throws when no element

clickByText.description: hoverClick the element inside a scope whose trimmed innerText equals the text, else the first button whose innerText includes it. Side effect: whatever the click does (Archive and Delete are real).

text.description: visible text, e.g. Settings, Create project

returns.description: {clicked:true, x, y}; throws when no match

shot.description: PNG of a clip of a background tab: 1280x820 at 2x override, Page.captureScreenshot with a clip, override cleared after. Default clip crops the 232 px sidebar. Side effect: writes outPath. Never publish a shot of the sidebar or Projects list of a real account.

clip.description: {x, y, width, height}; default {x:232,y:0,width:1048,height:820}; for a dialog pass its rect
